text:
toni: FYI - onboarding CLI smoke found a weird rerank failure. one vector in a 64-item batch was 1535 while expected 1536 and server rejected. looks like it only happens when tokens rotate during heavy load.
rachel: can you share the server rejection and the sampleapp behavior?
toni: server: 
``` 
[2026-05-20T08:32:11Z] ERROR embeddings.validate: batch_rejected expected_dim=1536 got_dim=1535 id=onboard-2026
```
The sample CLI was set to --pad-vectors by default which masked the issue by silently padding with 0s.
arjun: interesting. i tracked it to the TypeScript batching helper: when an auth refresh forces a split-and-requeue, the slice math drops the last float for that item (off-by-one in the tail-slice code).
rachel: so two UX problems: 1) inconsistent default behavior between CLI/sampleapps and SDKs, 2) poor error metadata when the API rejects. both make onboarding painful.
toni: proposal: Make SDK/samples strict by default (fail-fast on dim mismatch). Add an explicit opt-in flag in CLI/sampleapps `--pad-vectors` or `padOnMismatch: true` in SDK config. Also populate the rejection with structured fields so users see {expected, got, index, sample_id}.
arjun: i'll patch the batching helper and add a focused unit test that simulates ephemeral-token-expiry mid-batch. sample change snippet (TS):
```ts
function validateShapes(vecs: number[][], expected: number) {
  for (let i = 0; i < vecs.length; i++) {
    const v = vecs[i];
    if (!Array.isArray(v) || v.length !== expected) {
      return { ok: false, idx: i, got: Array.isArray(v) ? v.length.toString() : 'non-array' };
    }
  }
  return { ok: true };
}
```
rachel: also let's improve the API 400 body to include a clear machine-readable reason so the SDK can surface a helpful error: e.g.,
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{
  "error": "vector_dim_mismatch",
  "expected": 1536,
  "got": 1535,
  "index": 42,
  "sample_id": "onboard-2026"
}
```
toni: agree. for parity we should add a `strictShape` option to Node/Python/Rust SDKs (default true). When false they can pad/trim but must emit a warning and increment metric `sdk.embed.invalid_dim.v2`.
arjun: i'll also add a small opt-in telemetry flag in the sample CLI `--telemetry-tag onboarding=true` so support can filter spikes during ramp.
docs-bot: Created doc note: "Embedding shape mismatch: strictShape default and sample CLI pad flag" (internal)
triage-bot: Created ticket DE-1601: "batching helper: fix requeue slice, add strictShape flag, improve 400" (https://git.internal/redwood/issues/DE-1601)
rachel: quick mitigation for the onboarding team: change sample CLI default to strict mode and surface a clear error with reproduction snippet. We'll call out how to enable legacy pad behavior.
toni: i'll coordinate a tiny sampleapp PR and a docs blurb. leaving an e2e test for the auth-refresh path in the helper repo.
arjun: PR incoming to fix the slice math + add validateShapes and tests.
rachel: thanks — once canary passes let's flip the sample default and ship a note to onboarding.
devex: closing loop pending PR merge and docs update.
